description: TripLedger is a private personal travel ledger for tracking journeys, stays, expenses, residency-day calculations, and Schengen 90/180 usage. It helps users organize travel records and related day-count calculations for a chosen ledger.
summary: TripLedger exposes one programmatic surface on its own domain: an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://my.tripledger.app/mcp`, which also accepts TripLedger-issued `tl_` API keys as Bearer tokens.
